Users can browse available vehicles, subscribe to a car, manage payments, and arrange delivery through the platform.

product.name: Invygo Monthly Car Subscription
product.description: A monthly car subscription service providing dealer-certified cars with included basic insurance and routine maintenance, available for 1 to 9 months with flexible cancellation.

product.name: Invygo Weekly Car Subscription
product.description: A weekly car subscription service offering dealer-certified cars with basic insurance and routine maintenance, designed for short-term use with flexible weekly plans.

product.name: Invygo Car Rental Service
product.description: A digital car rental platform offering a variety of dealer-verified cars for rent with flexible terms, including no deposit and free delivery options.

product.name: Invygo Subscription with Upgrade Option
product.description: A subscription feature allowing customers to upgrade their car to a different model after the first month within their subscription period.
